steps.note: States h=100, v=binom(h,3)=161700, banks X_a,Y_a indexed by a in T^3, N=v^3, m=h^3=10^6 (paper 653-660); builds the forward invocation with gather/scatter/copy/injection, the three stages forward/inverse/forward giving (x,y)->(x,y+x)->(-y,y+x)->(-y,x), i.e. (X_a,Y_a)->(-Y_a,X_a), with every scratch wire restored for arbitrary initial values (matches Lemma at 728-765), and the wire counts W_b, W_c (777-782). Reason: the page calls it the finite building block of the later tape procedures, and its Where-this-fits box spells out the plan (network -> frames -> rank per edge -> s<Wm -> recurrence).

Gives frames D_v per source/gate/sink, the same D_v on all incidences of a gate, edge operator D_v D_u^{-1}, the invariant, the commutation G(D_v g_1,...)=D_v G(g_1,...), the implemented operator D_out S_Omega D_in^{-1}, and the telescoping to endpoint frames on each route including scratch roles (paper 793-825). Section 'What the free frames are for' says an edge costs whatever applying D_v D_u^{-1} costs, so interior frames are chosen to make edges cheap, and points to the labels page and the recurrence.

Labels are nondegenerate subspaces of F (x) F (x) F of dimension m (bit: Q^h with form x.y-(1/9)(x.1)(y.1); complex: F_2^h), terminal labels table, stage transitions via [G|E], the per-time label table for centre/side/X/Y wires, and 'every arrow is an inclusion except centre 3->4, which drops P(x)F(x)Q of dimension h' (matches 856-1010 and Lemma 997-1010). Reason: 'the labelling chooses the frames ... so that a network ... costs s<Wm smaller calls, the saving the recursion needs' and 'to save, the labels must confine all loss to one small edge'.

For nondegenerate U in U', Pi_{U'}-Pi_U projects onto U' cap U^perp and has rank dim U'-dim U, negated on reversed edges; the exception is the first edge of each X_a, where the dimension change is zero but 2 Pi_{U_a} has rank one (paper 1156-1166). Reason given just before: each matrix gives a frame adding it times one address chunk to another, so an edge costs one smaller call per unit of rational rank, which turns call counting into dimension counting.

Source dimensions sum to N, sink dimensions to Wm-N, signed changes telescope at gates to Wm-2N, absolute changes Wm-2N+2L, L_b=I c_b h, L_c=I c_c h, and s_b=(W_b m-2N+2L_b)+N=W_b m-(N-2L_b) (paper 891-897, 997-1010, 1147-1153). rank-recurrence.md restates the budget intuitively (bank wires save 2N, shrinking edges cost 2L, the bit source sign adds one rank each). Reason: s is the number of smaller calls the recursion pays for.

L_b/N=3c_b h/v=100/539 and L_c/N=101/539, both below 1/2 (paper 1105-1110); deficit N-2L_b=(339/539)N>0 so s_b<W_b m (1167), with relative deficit 339/22587335000000 (1319-1324). rank-recurrence.md explains why strictness matters: with s=Wm the cost is proportional to Vf, no saving; the exponent log_m(s/W) is below 1 exactly when the deficit is positive.

subspace-labels.md: the negative source matrix -Pi_{U_a} makes every route's endpoint difference Id, the same shear on every role (Pi_{U_a^perp}+Pi_{U_a} from X_a to Y_a, Pi_F-0 elsewhere), matching 1169-1171. address-interchange.md states M_out(rho(w))-M_in(w)=I_m and derives f'_{rho(w)}=Phi_{I_m} f_w, so H<-H+D on every original row including scratch rows (1138-1145, 1519-1533). Reason: address-interchange.md says the interchange is D<-D-H, H<-H+D, D<-H-D and only the middle shear uses the circuit. The identity is split across two pages; subspace-labels.md does not itself say what the common shear is for.

matrix-shear.md gives A=E_1 Pi E_2 with lower triangular E_1,E_2 and Pi having exactly a ones, the elimination proof, reduction mod q^b, triangular parts in O(V), and the one-interchange implementation of each H_i<-H_i+D_j, so exactly a interchanges plus O(V) (paper 1364-1447). address-interchange.md: each edge frame change Phi_{A_i} is a shear by A_i 'which is why an edge costs its rank', and 'the number of recursive calls is the sum of the edge ranks, exactly s' (1543). matrix-shear's Where-this-fits box ties it to the F_k recurrence.

Role streams of volume V/W, node work O(V), F_0=O(1), F_k<=(s/W)F_{k-1}+O(1), geometric-sum case split c<=1 / c>1, F_k=O(e^tau) with e=m^k (paper 1497-1557); tau=1-2^{-50} justified from eta>20*2^{-50} and ln m<20 so m^{1-2^{-50}}>m(1-eta)=s/W (1319-1344). rank-recurrence.md gives the same recurrence as C(mf)<=(s/W)C(f)+O(1) and the explicit exponent. Reason: the O(V u^tau) interchange is one of the two power-saving tape procedures the main result rests on, and its users (transform layout, cost accounting) are linked.

summary: Yes: W1 carries a reader from the fixed exchange network to the exponent. All nine steps are reconstructed with the paper's defining content and a stated purpose, and the four frames-and-rank-deficit pages chain into address-interchange.md and matrix-shear.md. No step breaks. The chain is thinnest at C7 to C8: the endpoint identity is first stated on subspace-labels.md without its use, and that page does not link forward to matrix-shear.md or address-interchange.md (the reader goes through rank-recurrence.md). Also, matrix-shear.md sits in Part 3, ahead of the network in reading order, so its role is clear only from its Where-this-fits box.
